author: codex:engineering
context: PR70 provides tested local transport supervision, but no real evidence of provider compatibility with generation v4/audit v5. Historical budgets are closed and existing output/case approvals cannot migrate.
decision: Use one fresh public case and propose at most two sequential invocations to test the unobserved provider/schema boundary before a larger campaign. Separate PO expectations approval from exact execution authorization and output review. Reuse existing typed preparation/runtime; do not add another orchestration layer or transfer historical approvals.

limitations: Proposed limits are not granted budget. PO has not approved this case or any new output.
A public synthetic development case does not establish independent evaluation or generalization.
Adding case approval changes the case/flow/request hashes; re-freeze before asking execution authorization.
Current freeze is host/runtime-specific metadata, not a hermetic environment or authenticated remote model.
One compatibility smoke cannot close AHC-021, qualify a model or complete Sprint 2.6.
review_note: Reviewed public input/expectation mapping and immutable proposed bindings, with three passing offline artifact checks. This activates engineering reference documentation, not PO case approval, real execution permission or model/output qualification.
summary: Prepare one new public pending case and exact proposed freeze for a two-invocation compatibility smoke. Obtain new case expectation approval first; then preserve this proposal, freeze an approved snapshot and obtain separate exact execution authorization. No inference executed.
title: Compatibilidade v4/v5 antes de campanha semântica maior
